wholePhysicalScope: The precise OpenStreetMap temple area validates the site. The central crossed roof and adjacent rectangular roof come from two identified Overture buildings orthogonal to the same forecourt.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the principal gilded tower, tiered tiled roofs, standing figure and neighboring hall. Near levels refine the finials, relief gables and lotus plinth.
limitations: The exact named temple area is mapped. The assignment of the photographed hall and neighbor to their roof outlines, roof rises, placement of the standing figure, and intricate gilded relief are photo-guided estimates.
The model represents the temple exterior shown in the reference and its adjoining roof. Remaining compound buildings and interiors are outside the authored scope.
